Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939),
I am sorry to trouble you again, but will you kindly tell me how to answer the letter from [Mrs Blackburn](/person/159) about the Illustrations to the [Little Duke](/book/20), which I sent about ten days ago - You see she says it must be settled quickly as she is going abroad
Yours faithfully
